decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Curator of Mysteries, Endurance, and Street Wraith to cycle through the deck and get key combo pieces into the graveyard. The goal is to cast Living End to bring back all of your creatures from the graveyard while wiping your opponent's board. Cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety help protect your combo from disruption, while creatures like Shardless Agent and Generous Ent help you dig deeper into your deck for your combo pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm your opponent with a powerful board presence after resolving Living End.

The deck focuses on combining reanimation spells and powerful creatures with abilities that disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Faithless Looting and Thoughtseize to fill up the graveyard with creatures like Emperor of Bones and Archon of Cruelty, followed by spells like Unearth and Persist to bring them back, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of card advantage and powerful threats. The inclusion of disruptive creatures like Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus adds an additional layer of disruption to control the game and secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Simic Growth Chamber to get Primeval Titan out as soon as possible. Once Primeval Titan is on the field, the goal is to use its ability to search for land cards such as Gruul Turf and Lotus Field to generate a massive amount of mana. This mana can then be used to cast game-winning spells like Scapeshift and Malevolent Rumble, allowing the player to overwhelm their opponent with a powerful combo.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive creature plays, utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes cards like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment for additional direct damage. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures while controlling the board with cards like Static Prison and Thraben Charm. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Arena of Glory provide additional support and buffs to the deck's creatures, allowing for a powerful offensive strategy.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a mix of red, white, green, and blue cards. The strategy involves playing powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Scion of Draco to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes efficient removal options like Lightning Bolt and Consign to Memory to control the board. Leyline Binding and Leyline of the Guildpact help to boost the deck's overall power level. Stubborn Denial provides additional protection while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fear of Missing Out offer versatile options for different situations.

The main concept of this Amulet Titan combo deck in Modern 1 vs 1 format is to utilize cards like Primeval Titan, Scapeshift, and Amulet of Vigor to quickly search and play lands such as Gruul Turf, Lotus Field, and Urza's Saga, ramping up mana generation and triggering powerful effects. By efficiently looping lands and creatures with the help of bounce lands and the Amulet, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a massive combo finish, either through creating a massive board presence or dealing lethal damage in a single turn.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful win condition without relying on traditional lands. It utilizes a combination of quick mana acceleration with cards like Lotus Bloom and Whir of Invention to cheat out powerful spells and combo pieces. Disruption and counter spells like Disrupting Shoal and Force of Negation help protect the combo. Cards like Tameshi, Reality Architect and Hydroelectric Specimen provide additional value and control options. The deck ultimately aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces, such as Goblin Charbelcher, to close out the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature plays combined with blinking effects to generate advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By using cards such as Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly exile and return key creatures like Emperor of Bones and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd, triggering their abilities multiple times. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide disruption and removal, while cards like Quantum Riddler and Solitude offer protection and control options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient creature beats and tricky maneuvering through blinking effects.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of powerful spells and creatures to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes Leyline cards to protect key permanents and generate advantage, while also employing a mix of counter spells and removal to handle threats. The deck also includes a companion, Keruga, the Macrosage, to provide additional card draw and value. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure access to various colors of mana for the deck's spells and abilities. Overall, the deck seeks to outlast and outmaneuver opponents through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creature plays and the ability to repeatedly blink or flicker them in and out of play. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Quantum Riddler, the deck can generate value from creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield effects. This allows for tempo plays and disruption through cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The deck also includes versatile creatures like Flickerwisp and Solitude for additional control options. Overall, the strategy aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast creature plays and disruptive interactions.

The main focus of this Esper Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and removal spells. By controlling the game and managing the opponent's threats, the deck aims to out-value the opponent and take over the game with powerful planeswalkers and finishers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Ketramose, the New Dawn. The deck also utilizes various creatures with disruptive abilities like Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus to further slow down the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls along with burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment, the deck aims to deal fast and consistent damage to the opponent. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah can provide additional support by buffing creatures and protecting them. The inclusion of cards like Arena of Glory and Voice of Victory can provide additional benefits and help to maintain aggression throughout the game.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be constantly blinked in and out of play to trigger powerful effects. By using cards like Flickerwisp and Ephemerate, the deck can repeatedly exile and return creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Emperor of Bones to generate card advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help control the early game, while cards like Overlord of the Balemurk and Solitude provide additional threats and removal options. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive plays.

The main focus of this deck is to use blink effects to continuously return and reuse powerful creatures and spells, gaining value and overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays. By repeatedly blinking creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Flickerwisp, players can disrupt the opponent's strategy and maintain pressure on the battlefield. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push provide disruption and removal, while Ephemerate and Quantum Riddler offer powerful synergy with the blink theme. The deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and strategic plays.

This deck focuses on combining aggressive creatures with cards that allow for repetition of powerful enter-the-battlefield effects. By efficiently removing threats and disrupting opponent's hands, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of hard-hitting creatures and disruptive plays. Cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp provide extra value by blink creatures for extra triggers. The deck also utilizes a mix of removal, hand disruption, and graveyard hate to maintain control of the game while pushing through damage and generating advantage through blinking creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost creatures and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Slickshot Show-Off, along with Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. The inclusion of cards like Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge allow for additional burst damage, while cards like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble help with card selection and draw. Overall, the deck focuses on tempo and aggression to win the game quickly.
